title: 小爪鲜货铺
theme: 原创小浣熊在林间鲜货铺里搬运、补货和扩建
concept: 只用移动完成采集、实体堆叠、补货、顾客结账、拾取现金和投建的空间物流经营游戏
coreLoop: 移动到生产点并靠近自动采集有类型商品
商品以可见堆叠显示在小浣熊头顶
移动到对应货架自动逐件补货
顾客选货、等货、取货并前往收银台排队
玩家在收银区完成交易并让现金实体化
靠近拾取现金后投入建设区或购买容量升级
扩建解锁第二产品并制造新的缺货与排队瓶颈

requiredSystems: normalized keyboard and pointer/touch drag movement
automatic proximity harvest and compatible-shelf delivery
customer finite state machine with out-of-stock waiting and checkout queue
physical cash pile collected by proximity
originalityConstraints: Do not use Monkey Mart names, code, assets, UI, map layout, tuning or unlock order
Use only the generic spatial logistics mechanic and generic produce categories
Keep all silhouettes, palette, layout, progression and numbers original
testRequirements: Add deterministic controls if needed without removing the contract
Test both products, stock compatibility, queue order, cash collection, construction unlock and save recovery
Test that repeating automatic interactions never trigger a full-screen camera flash
